pr_title: session, infosync: add a cursor tracker to the session to keep tracking all needed information of the cursor.
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #54113

Problem Summary:

The `min-start-ts` of the cursor is not tracked, so that the safe point may advance to be greater than the `startTS` used by the cursor.

### What changed and how does it work?

Add a cursor tracker on the session, and expose a read-only interface.

issue_context.title: Add a `CursorTracker` to track the `min-start-ts` of each cursor.
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

We should track all existing cursors on a session, and store the state (`min-start-ts`, and any other things needed), so that the cursor can be observed.

review_comments: The original implementation is not correct. The `sessVars.TxnCtx.StartTS` is not cleared after `Commit`, so that a pending session will always have a small start ts.
